svg.aria-label: Rana Sheraz Ahmad - genomics terminal session

g.text: rana_sheraz_ahmad # Bioinformatics Research Associate, SBASSE, LUMS
sheraz@lums:~$ bwa-mem2 mem -R '@RG\tID:S1\tSM:S1' hg38.fa R1.fq.gz R2.fq.gz | samtools sort -o S1.bam

text.tspan: [M::mem_process_seqs] Processed 1000000 reads in 612.390 CPU sec, 41.203 real sec

g.text: sheraz@lums:~$ gatk HaplotypeCaller -R hg38.fa -I S1.bam -O S1.g.vcf.gz -ERC GVCF

text.tspan: INFO ProgressMeter - Traversal complete. Processed 1573942 total regions in 38.1 minutes.

g.text: sheraz@lums:~$ gatk GenotypeGVCFs -R hg38.fa -V cohort.g.vcf.gz -D dbsnp.vcf.gz -O snps.vcf.gz

text.tspan: INFO ProgressMeter - Traversal complete. Processed 214387 total variants in 6.4 minutes.

g.text: sheraz@lums:~$ bcftools stats snps.vcf.gz | grep -E 'number of (samples|SNPs)'
sheraz@lums:~$ bcftools view -H -r chr20:12014800-12016000 snps.vcf.gz | cut -f1-5
sheraz@lums:~$ plink2 --vcf snps.vcf.gz --pheno ocd.pheno --covar covar.txt --glm hide-covar --out ocd

text.tspan: 482 samples (0 females, 0 males, 482 ambiguous; 482 founders) loaded from snps.vcf.gz.
--glm logistic-Firth hybrid regression on phenotype 'OCD': done.

g.text: sheraz@lums:~$ Rscript manhattan_qq.R ocd.OCD.glm.logistic.hybrid # qqman: Manhattan + QQ plots
